title: Definitional drift: solution's generators are not the problem's dihedral invariants (G4)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: The relation ideal $I$ is generator-specific. The problem's $u_1,\dots,u_m$ are the *canonical Gutierrez–Shaska dihedral invariants*. The solution replaces them by an arbitrary generating set (Noether-bound monomials, Hilbert-basis monomials $a^{h_j}$, symmetrizations). Even the $g=2$ Example 4.1 uses $u_1=a_1a_2,\,u_2=a_1^3+a_2^3$, which are not the standard published dihedral invariants of $\mathcal L_2$. Computing $\ker\Phi$ for a *different* generating set answers a different question unless the explicit polynomial dictionary between the two generating families (and the induced isomorphism of presentations) is supplied. This is missing, so faithfulness to 'the dihedral invariants' is not established.
